tagline: Up to four pitch-shifted voices at fixed intervals, each panned
description: A harmonizer that adds one to four voices, each set to a fixed interval of -24 to +24 semitones and its own pan position, then filtered and mixed with the dry signal. The Scale setting snaps each interval to the nearest step of the chosen scale; it does not detect the sung note. The pitch shifter is a single delay-line read without crossfading and does not yet produce the set intervals correctly, and the Formant Shift control is a placeholder that does nothing.

features.name: Four interval voices
features.description: Voices sets how many of the four voices play; each has a Pitch control from -24 to +24 semitones (defaults +3, +7, +12, -12).

features.name: Per-voice panning
features.description: Each voice has a Pan control from -100 to +100 with constant-power panning.

features.name: Scale snapping
features.description: Twelve scale choices (Chromatic, Major, Minor, the modes, Harmonic Minor, Melodic Minor, Pentatonic) round each voice's interval to a scale step.

features.name: Voice filtering
features.description: A high-pass (20 to 500 Hz) and low-pass (2 to 20 kHz) filter shape the harmony voices only.

features.name: Mix and output gain
features.description: Mix blends dry and harmony signal (0 to 100%), and Output Gain trims the harmonies by -12 to +12 dB.
